prompt_md: Your first three quiz scores average 70. What score do you need on the fourth quiz to bring your average up to 75?
prompt_short: Three quizzes average 70. Fourth score needed to average 75?
hint_md: How many total points do you need after four quizzes?
explain_intuition_md: Lifting the average by 5 means lifting all four scores by 5 each, a 20-point gap. The fourth quiz has to cover it alone: 70 plus 20.
